en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone arched bridge with three main arches spanning a rocky riverbed in a valley. Low mountains or hills rise in the background. On the riverbank near the bridge are a horse-drawn cart and several people. Printed caption text appears below the image in French, identifying the location as Blida, Vallée des Moulins, and the bridge over the Oued-El-Kébir.
